test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 19 July 2012 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 January 2018?
solution:
**Given:** 19 July 2012 is Thursday

The number of odd days from 19 July 2012 to 11 January 2018 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2012
 19 July 2012 - 31 December 2012
 12 July + 31 August + 30 September + 31 October + 30 November + 31 December = 165 days
 165 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 2013 - 2017
 Full years (4 Ordinary years + 1 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 4 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 1 Leap years) = 6 odd days
 6
 
 

 2011
 1st January 2011 - 11 January 2018
 11 January = 11 days
 11 ÷ 7 = 4
 
 

 Total odd days
 (14 ÷ 7) = **0**
 
 

∴ The number of odd days from 19 July 2012 to 11 January 2018 ⇒ 0

⇒So, Zero odd days will be added to Thursday because the day is asked in future.

∴ Thursday was the day of the week on 11 January 2018.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
